LABUAN LIMITED PARTNERSHIPS AND LIMITED LIABILITY PARTNERSHIPS ACT

LABUAN LIMITED PARTNERSHIPS AND LIMITED LIABILITY PARTNERSHIPS

(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 89(1) of the

Labuan Limited Partnerships and Limited Liability Partnerships Act 2010 [Act 707],

the Minister, on the recommendation of the Authority, makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Labuan Limited Partnerships

and Limited Liability Partnerships (Amendment) Regulations 2026.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 July 2026.

Substitution of Third Schedule

2. The Labuan Limited Partnerships and Limited Liability Partnerships

Regulations 2010 [P.U. (A) 419/2010] are amended by substituting for

the Third Schedule the following schedule:
